sections.heading: ABOUT THESE TERMS
paragraphs: These sample terms describe how stays, bookings and website use are handled at Kemuning Sanur. They are placeholder text for this demonstration project and should be reviewed by the property's own legal adviser before use.
By making a booking or using this website you agree to the terms below.

sections.heading: RATES AND AVAILABILITY
paragraphs: Rates are quoted in Indonesian rupiah per bungalow per night and include breakfast unless stated. Service charge and government tax are shown separately in your quotation.
All rates, offers and packages depend on availability and may change without notice until a booking is confirmed.

sections.heading: BOOKINGS AND DEPOSITS
paragraphs: A booking is confirmed when we send you a written confirmation. We may ask for a deposit or a card guarantee, which will be stated in your confirmation.
Please check the dates, names and room type in your confirmation and tell us of any error as soon as possible.

sections.heading: CHECK-IN AND CHECK-OUT
paragraphs: Check-in is from 2 pm and check-out is by 12 noon. Early arrival or late departure can often be arranged and is subject to availability.

sections.heading: CANCELLATIONS AND CHANGES
paragraphs: Free cancellation applies until the date stated in your confirmation. After that, the first night may be charged. Special offers and packages may carry stricter conditions, which are shown at the time of booking.
If you do not arrive and have not told us, the booking may be treated as a no-show.

sections.heading: CHILDREN
paragraphs: Children are warmly welcome. We ask families to help keep our gardens, restaurant and pool pleasant for everyone, and to supervise children near water at all times. Some bungalows have steep stairs and are not suitable for young children.

sections.heading: PRICING ERRORS
paragraphs: If a price or description on this website is clearly wrong, we may correct it before confirming your booking.

sections.heading: LIABILITY
paragraphs: We take care to keep the information on this website accurate, but we cannot accept liability for errors or omissions. To the extent permitted by law, we are not responsible for loss arising from the use of this website.
Please look after your belongings and use the in-room safe for valuables.

sections.heading: PRIVACY
paragraphs: We use the details you give us only to handle your booking and to answer your enquiry. We do not sell personal information. You can ask us to correct or delete your details at any time.
